subject: Adopter Path: collaborative enablement sprint and implementation canvas
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@stratusconsulting.com>, Devika Rao <devika@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Adopter Path: collaborative enablement sprint and implementation canvas

Hi Liam + Devika —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Based on what we discussed I sketched an "Adopter Path" proposal intended to get Stratus customers from initial integration to revenue-readiness in 8 weeks. Attached: SI_Enablement_Canvas_v1.xlsx and MVP_scope_doc.pdf.

High-level ask: can your delivery leads commit to a 3-week joint enablement sprint (week 1: discovery + install, week 2: joint labs + training, week 3: pilot support + go/no-go)? We propose the following kickoff slots next week: Tue 5/30 10–11am PT or Thu 6/1 9–10am PT.

Key goals for kickoff:
- Align scope and acceptance criteria for the MVP pilot
- Confirm roles (Stratus PM, Redwood SI lead, Integration Engineer)
- Agree on training calendar and certification criteria

Attachments: SI_Enablement_Canvas_v1.xlsx (implementation canvas), MVP_scope_doc.pdf (scope & success metrics).

If that timeline is aggressive, tell us which portions you prefer to stretch.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a one-pager for the delivery leads.

Priya Natarajan
Sr. Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0164

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@stratusconsulting.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devika Rao <devika@cloudforge.io>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 13:26:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Adopter Path: collaborative enablement sprint and implementation canvas

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear canvas. Quick responses inline: 

- 3-week sprint is possible but we want to split the pilot support into two weeks (pilot + stabilization) — we usually do a light stabilization week after the pilot to handle data edge cases.
- Tue 5/30 10am PT works for me. Devika, can you confirm?
- We'll need an estimate for Redwood-delivered training hours and a partner discount reference for the reseller uplift you mentioned; also who will lead the joint lab?

I can share a Stratus delivery contact (Sara Morton) and a short Partner SOW template if that helps.

Subject: Re: Adopter Path: collaborative enablement sprint and implementation canvas

Liam / team —

Happy to lead the technical side for Redwood. A couple of practical notes from the runtime/ops perspective: 

1) Pre-kickoff checklist (we'll run this with Stratus eng): vnet connectivity + service endpoints, model selection & quantization profile, expected seq lengths and traffic patterns (est. qps).
2) Labs: propose two 90-minute hands-on modules (module A: local integration + auth; module B: caching/batching & latency tuning). We'll provide a lab environment and sample prompts.
3) Certification: basic partner badge requires passing two checklists and a demo run with a sample customer dataset. We can reuse Redwood's training-modules-outline.docx (attached).

I'll prepare a short tech-runbook and a shared drive with sample code before the kickoff. Priya — can we add a line item in the SOW for "Redwood lab hours (6)"? That helps with billing and expectations.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

This looks good — happy to own the partner enablement lab week. Quick notes: 
- Estimate: 6 lab hours + 4 office hours for pilot stabilization (we charge per-hour for extra support; rough estimate $4k MSRP, we can apply a 20% partner uplift discount if Stratus is reselling).
- We should bake an optional "customer shadow day" into week 3 for the first pilot customer to validate handoff.

Happy to put together the lab agenda — I can drop a calendar invite once kickoff is locked.

Ben Carter

Great — thanks everyone for the quick alignment. Finalizing next steps below: 

1) Kickoff: Tue 2028-05-30 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow)
2) Deliverables before kickoff (Priya): one-pager SOW draft, canvas (attached), and HubSpot deal link — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1147
3) Deliverables before kickoff (Stratus): named delivery lead (Sara Morton) and any customer pilot dataset they can share in advance
4) Redwood lead items: Karthik to prepare tech runbook + lab env; Ben to prepare lab agenda and estimate; Laura to prepare partner-facing slide deck and pricing slide (Laura, can you share by Mon 5/28 EOD?)
5) Billing note: add "Redwood lab hours (6)" to SOW. Ben suggested $4k MSRP (we'll apply partner uplift rules at contracting).
